name: Sherri Shepherd
bio: Sherri Evonne Shepherd is an American comedienne, actress, and television personality. She is one of five co-hosts on the ABC daytime talkshow, The View, as well as being the current host of the Newlywed Game. As an actress, she had a recurring role as Angie Jordan on the NBC series 30 Rock, starred in the sitcom Less Than Perfect and her own sitcom Sherri on Lifetime.
